name: Simone Adeyemi

sections.heading: Profile
items: Business analyst with 6+ years bridging the gap between data and strategic decision-making across financial services, e-commerce, and operations. Experienced in requirements gathering, process mapping, and delivering insight-driven recommendations that directly influence product and business direction.

items.title: Sr. Business Analyst, Vantara Financial Services
bullets: Leads requirements definition and solution design for a portfolio of digital banking products, working directly with product owners, engineers, and compliance teams to deliver initiatives on time.
Identified a process inefficiency in the loan approval workflow that, once addressed, reduced average processing time by 3 days and saved an estimated $600K annually.

items.title: Business Analyst, Broadfield E-Commerce Group
bullets: Partnered with marketing and logistics teams to analyze customer journey data and surface friction points in the checkout experience, contributing to a 22% reduction in cart abandonment.
Maintained and improved a suite of operational Power BI reports used across four regional offices to track fulfillment and returns performance.
Facilitated workshops with business stakeholders to translate high-level objectives into detailed functional requirements for two major platform releases.

items.title: Jr. Business Analyst, Harcastle Consulting
bullets: Supported senior analysts on client engagements spanning retail, healthcare, and logistics, contributing to process mapping, data gathering, and presentation of findings.
Built Excel-based financial models used to evaluate cost-reduction scenarios for a mid-size manufacturing client.
Assisted in the delivery of a business case that secured $1.2M in internal investment for a supply chain modernization project.
